notes.title: Update 0.1.7 - Dynamic Lighting
notes.notes:
v0.1.7-beta
This update brings new dynamic lighting FX that dramatically enhance the atmosphere! 

Weapons and items now interact with the environment through real-time light emission - like muzzle flashes, fire, and explosions. New items have been introduced to take full advantage of the lighting system, making gameplay feel more intense and immersive.
Night Vision  
Available as a new default equipment item (available for all classes)

Always available in Operations (press N)
Flashlight  
Available as a new weapon attachment

Customizable color (just like the Laser attachment)

Toggle by pressing T
Night Mode
Sets the map very dark - Flashlights + Night Vision are essential

Combine with Hardcore mode for a challenge!
Battlezone Updates  
Added Hostages for extra loot rewards

Extraction Helicopter now armed with rockets

New enemies

Fixed map ladder positions
Other Notes 
Updated Zombie Survival player loadout

Increased ACR 6.8 damage

Bot improvements

Added chat text limit

Other UI/bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.1.6 - Battlezone
notes.notes:
v0.1.6-beta 
This update includes the first revision of Battlezone, a new extraction game mode where players can loot credits and XP!  
Battlezone Overview  
Multiplayer only - recommended for experienced players

Massive randomly generated map

Full day/night cycle with dynamic weather

Mercenary airdrops of different factions who fight each other

Zombies and Infestors come out during the night

Keep an eye out for the Extraction Helicopter to deposit your loot

Random crates and objects can be destroyed to find weapons, ammo, loot, or enemies
Other Notes
Characters can now jump while sliding

Increased character mantle distance

Adjusted .50 BMG sniper rifle damages

Increased AUG HBAR mobility

Increased lethality for Zombie Spitters and Zombie Spitter Bosses

Added restart button for custom server multiplayer games

Fixed bug where Claymores could be moved

Fixed weapon skin localizations

Editor updates

Other minor bug fixes
Early Access
The Early Access release is happening next month - make sure you add it to your Wishlist!



Join the official Discord here!

notes.title: Update 0.1.5
notes.notes:
v0.1.5-beta


This update includes a highly-requested feature: Custom Servers!


Create Server
You can now host a multiplayer server from within the game! Multiple regions are available. In addition to the Standard and Survival game modes, you can use these servers to play Operations with teammates in multiplayer.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352901/f859f9473739d01f58ab1fedbccf437f73bdd11e.png"]
Other Notes
Added Jammer

Railgun and Deadswitch now available in the Tactical Crate

RC-XD is now available as a Support class equipment

Improved friendly UGV in Survival (increased HP and harder to flip over)

Equipment can now be repaired with the Repair Tool

Added money multiplier to Survival

New Shadow Company soldier items

New Survival enemies (including Dragonfire and Reaper)

Fixed money reward for Infestors

Other bug fixes


Discord
Remember to join the Discord to submit any feedback or suggestions!

notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.notes:
v0.1.4-beta
This is a big update with a lot of new content!

While the Next Fest demo is no longer available, you can get the latest build from the Discord server!
Operations
Operations return from Deadswitch 3! Select a mission and set the difficulty (Novice, Hard, or Veteran) to earn rewards. 

Currently, all DS3 Operations are available (including the campaign) with unique DSC Operations coming in future updates.
Game of the Day
Earn more Credits by completing the Game of the Day! 

A new game is generated every 24hr and is the same for all players.
New Weapons + Equipment
SCAR-12

Taser

Adrenaline
New Vehicles + Support + Enemies
UGV

RC-XD

Reaper

Infestors
Soldier Customization
New appearance items (like the Ghillie suit and many more)

New Callsigns

Parachute color can now be customized
Editor
Added ability to show/hide layers

New objects
Other Notes
Added player spray paint ability (default V)

Challenges now show how many players have completed them

New stats: Team Wipe and Daily Game Events Completed

New weapon skins

Repair Tool is now the default equipment for Engineer

Rebalanced Juggernauts (increased headshot damage)

Improved bot skill for VIP in Assassination

Fixed performance drop bug for extra long games

Lots of other UI and bug fixes
